scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy -e prod --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.deploy:dev: wrangler deploy -e dev --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy -e staging --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=fotoowlai --project=upload-worker && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=fotoowlai --project=upload-worker --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
